name: openai-skills-superpowers
description: Expose OpenAI/Agent Skills as Ouroboros-native command superpowers with permission, audit, provenance, and handoff semantics.

commands.name: catalog-refresh
commands.summary: Refresh the pinned Agent Skill catalog projection.

arguments.name: source
arguments.description: Source repository slug or local source path.

arguments.name: ref
arguments.description: Pinned ref or commit SHA to ingest.

commands.name: catalog-list
commands.summary: List cataloged Agent Skills and their command projections.

commands.name: inspect
commands.summary: Inspect a cataloged skill and show inferred permissions, resources, and command exposure.

arguments.name: skill_name
arguments.description: Cataloged skill name or bucket-qualified name such as system/openai-docs.

commands.name: handoff
commands.summary: Generate an Ouroboros-readable handoff artifact for a skill invocation.

arguments.name: task
arguments.description: Task text for the skill handoff.

commands.name: run
commands.summary: Run a cataloged Agent Skill through the Ouroboros plugin firewall.

commands.name: trust-plan
commands.summary: Explain the exact permissions and trust decision needed before a skill can run.

commands.name: doctor
commands.summary: Check the superpowers plugin catalog and trust-policy readiness.

capabilities.name: handoff
capabilities.reason: Attach superpower invocation outputs to Ouroboros workflows.

capabilities.name: provenance
capabilities.reason: Record skill source, ref, loaded files, and execution evidence.

capabilities.name: ledger
capabilities.reason: Record superpower invocation and trust decisions.

capabilities.name: state
capabilities.reason: Cache the skill catalog and pinned refs.

capabilities.name: progress
capabilities.reason: Report blocked, failed, and completed superpower invocations.

permissions.reason: Read cached skill files and local resources.
Write catalog cache, audit logs, and handoff artifacts.
Fetch or refresh skills from GitHub.
Run bundled skill scripts only after explicit trust.
